# HashPilot — Tech Fernandes

> Windows desktop monitor for Pearl (PRL) mining with up to six NVIDIA GPUs: UUID-scoped telemetry, miner/controller/benchmark isolation, persistent SQLite history, wallet-deduplicated pool balances, payout estimates, and PRL/BRL/USD/BTC equivalents.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/TechFernandesLTDA/hashpilot

## Read first

- [Verification and evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TechFernandesLTDA/hashpilot/main/docs/verification.md): deterministic source releases, allowlisted diagnostics, passive 24/72-hour protocol; no independent audit or hardware certification claimed.

- [Measured RTX 3070 observation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TechFernandesLTDA/hashpilot/main/docs/performance/rtx3070.md): 15-minute observation, independent hashrate updates, power, temperature and limitations; not a universal overclock or A/B comparison.
- [Observation aggregates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TechFernandesLTDA/hashpilot/main/docs/performance/rtx3070-observation.json): machine-readable methodology and aggregate evidence.
- [Demo provenance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TechFernandesLTDA/hashpilot/main/media/README.md): historical v0.1.0, single-GPU UI captured in an isolated renderer using real local data; not evidence of six physical devices.

- [Portuguese README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TechFernandesLTDA/hashpilot/main/README.md): product scope, Windows install command, default author wallet and hardware limits.
- [English README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TechFernandesLTDA/hashpilot/main/README.en.md): English introduction and the same important defaults.
- [Documentation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TechFernandesLTDA/hashpilot/main/docs/index.md): navigation.
- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TechFernandesLTDA/hashpilot/main/docs/installation.md): Windows setup and onboarding.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TechFernandesLTDA/hashpilot/main/docs/architecture.md): modules, data flow and side-effect boundaries.
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TechFernandesLTDA/hashpilot/main/docs/faq.md): common questions.
- [Technical reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TechFernandesLTDA/hashpilot/main/docs/reference.md): detailed legacy documentation preserved for context.

## Correct interpretation

- [Operations center](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TechFernandesLTDA/hashpilot/main/docs/operations.md): pool ACK health, persistent three-per-hour recovery budget, per-GPU profiles, measured adjustment history, contribution audit, private SQLite backups, restoration and allowlisted diagnostics. v0.4.0 separates panel/service/controller/miner versions and financial-source freshness. Backups exclude AI credentials and contribution reservations; restoration preserves local credentials and asks users to review wallets before starting the rig.

- The initial receiving address is the author's PUBLIC wallet. Keeping it sends mining payouts to the author. Users can replace it in setup. No seed/private key is required.
- GPU telemetry is NVIDIA-only via nvidia-smi. The Windows RTX 3070 is the validated reference mining profile. A catalog entry is not a validated overclock; per-device measurements matter.
- The catalog documents 158 NVIDIA models with primary sources, not 158 validated overclocks. gpu_agent.py supports driver/UUID identification, a 300-second baseline, manual benchmark requests, explicit adaptive --control and optional CPU Ollama. No paid AI API is required.
- The current dashboard supports up to six NVIDIA GPUs, identical or different, keyed by persistent driver UUID. Each has independent enable/disable, effective wallet, miner, controller, logs and benchmark. Newly detected GPUs default enabled in settings; opening the UI never starts mining. The rig service must be started explicitly before it reconciles desired enabled devices. Devices beyond six are reported and ignored.
- A GPU inherits the global public wallet unless gpu_settings[UUID].wallet overrides it. Settings use gpu_settings[UUID] = {enabled: true, wallet: null}. Disabling a managed GPU stops only its owned processes. Names and ordinal indices are not stable device identities; NVIDIA and SRBMiner indices can differ and must be matched by PCI bus.
- Actual pool balances/credits are deduplicated by effective wallet. Multiple GPUs sharing one wallet do not multiply its balance. Hashrate and power can be summed, but realized per-GPU coins cannot be inferred from hashrate proportions. Missing wallet sources mean incomplete data, not zero.
- Physical evidence on this computer covers one RTX 3070. Six-device scenarios are simulated tests, not measurements of six physical cards. Historical v0.1.0 media and performance observations remain single-device evidence. Generic control reads actual driver limits; historical RTX 3070 presets remain separate.
- The product supports Windows 10/11 x64 only. Backup and transfer documentation refers to Windows computers.
- An optional, visible, disableable contribution routes 5% of mining time (57 minutes user / 3 minutes author) through a TCP proxy without restarting GPU or miner. It applies only to an address different from the author's; the default author address gets no extra split. SRBMiner's 2% developer fee is separate. Forecasts deduct the expected contribution when enabled; actual pool credits must not be deducted again.
- Actual observed credits are distinct from hashrate-based forecasts. Incomplete history is partial, and missing data is N/D rather than invented zero.
- USD and BTC values are current-price equivalents. Pool payouts remain PRL; the app does not perform an exchange.
- The payout threshold is the configured wallet's API threshold. Pending balance is not confirmed balance, and pool-sent does not itself prove wallet synchronization.
- portable-data contains an explicitly authorized, dated AUTHOR snapshot. It is not earnings generated by a new user's machine. Existing local history is not overwritten during bootstrap.
- SQLite history has no automatic retention deletion. Short graph/cache windows do not delete the permanent archive.
- Code is GPL-3.0-only. Tech Fernandes names and logos are not licensed under GPL; read LICENSE and NOTICE.

Testing: mise exec -- python -m unittest discover -v. UI/windowing QA is opt-in and must distinguish physical displays from virtual 4K cases. Do not run mining or apply clocks merely to inspect the application.

AI providers / Provedores de IA: [OpenRouter Cloud Free, OpenCode Cloud Free e Ollama local](docs/ai-providers.md). A política adaptativa funciona sem IA.
